trainer/31283.htm.text: Magister Alminas: Do you feel it? This whole area thrums with fire energy! Perhaps it's due to the volcanic mountain located to the north. Fire energy is mysterious and alluring, but it's very unusual for aquatic-minded Elves to grasp. But for magisters like me, it is a fascinating area of research.

trainer/31283-noteach.htm.text: Magister Alminas: I only teach Elven mystics and wizards. Find someone in the village to teach you.

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/11-01.htm.text: Magister Alminas: Have you come in search of the Resonace Amulet? I came upon it by chance while exploring some ancient ruins in the course of my research. I would like to help you, but my Resonance Amulet is currently installed as an activation device for a prototype weapon that I am developing. S…

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/11-02.htm.text: Magister Alminas: To get the Resonance Amulet, there are two ways. One way is to defeat the Demon Halisha, who is located within the Four Sepulchers. you must form a party to enter. If that proves too difficult, defeat the followers of Halisha at the Shrine of Loyalty. By doing so, you can earn "ti…

Q00089_SagaOfTheMysticMuse/2-01.htm.text: Magister Alminas: Arkenias didn't know that I'm conducting an investigation under the guise of Alminas. In a letter I intercepted Arkenias wanted Alminas to discourage you from becoming a Mystic Muse! Don't worry, since I'm not bound to him I can still tell you what you need to do to become one.

Q00089_SagaOfTheMysticMuse/2-02.htm.text: Magister Alminas: Visit Information Broker Mist at the hot springs resort and pick up the Investigative Report I requested. Tell him the silver light wanderer sent you. Bring the report and I'll tell you how to get the power of the six stone tablets.

Q00089_SagaOfTheMysticMuse/2-03.htm.text: Magister Alminas: Thanks for the report. This merits further investigation. To become a Mystic Muse, you'll need a Stone of Commune for each of the six stone tablets. Use the stones to commune with the tablets and your path will become clear. Here's the first Stone of Commune, take it to the Tablet…

Q00089_SagaOfTheMysticMuse/2-04.htm.text: Magister Alminas: Commune with the Tablet of Vision south of the Tower of Insolence with the Stone of Commune I gave you . The path will then become clear.

Q00089_SagaOfTheMysticMuse/3-01.htm.text: Magister Alminas: You say you fought with Allector, the fallen angel? How could he have escaped the prison in the Ivory Tower? He must have had help. But who? It could only be .... I shouldn't say, I need more proof. I have the Stone of Commune, but it's unstable. You'll need the other fragment .

Q00089_SagaOfTheMysticMuse/3-05.htm.text: Magister Alminas: The Divine Stone of Wisdom! Good work. My hunch was right. The only person who could have freed Allector is indeed the Grand Magister of the Ivory Tower! Never let your guard down, there are powerful forces trying to stop you! Shall I combine the stones now?

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
